_notes: Plague Depths boss loot (2026-10-23). ONE item drops per kill from the pool. item_level = creature level + 3; real loot formulas (tools/build_durotar_content.make).

Plagueweaver Vex.name: Plaguethread Spindle
Plagueweaver Vex.flavor_text: A bone needle as long as a forearm. The Society used it to sew the conspiracy together, and to unpick the loyal.

Plagueweaver Vex.name: Fevered-Silk Robes
Plagueweaver Vex.flavor_text: Cloth spun from something that should not spin. It clings, and it is warm, and it is not yours.

Plagueweaver Vex.name: Weaver's Mourning Wraps
Plagueweaver Vex.flavor_text: Black thread over black leather. Each stitch is a name. She ran out of room.

Plagueweaver Vex.name: Wand of Slow Rot
Plagueweaver Vex.flavor_text: A wand of grey wood, speckled where the blight has found it. It does not hurry.

The Infected Noble.name: Faulkner's Rotting Claymore
The Infected Noble.flavor_text: A nobleman's two-hander, still gilded at the quillons and green everywhere else.

The Infected Noble.name: Gilded Gauntlets of the Fallen House
The Infected Noble.flavor_text: Plate that remembers a coat of arms. The gilding is peeling, and so is the owner.

The Infected Noble.name: Moth-Eaten Ermine Mantle
The Infected Noble.flavor_text: A court mantle the moths found first. They left the dignity and took the rest.

The Infected Noble.name: Signet of the Last Heir
The Infected Noble.flavor_text: A ring for a house with one name left. It is not the wearer's.

Plague Keeper Voss.name: Keeper's Index-Staff
Plague Keeper Voss.flavor_text: A long staff of bound spines. Each vertebra is a section of the catalogue, and none is out of order.

Plague Keeper Voss.name: Archivist's Hood of Quiet
Plague Keeper Voss.flavor_text: A cowl lined with paper. It muffles every sound but the one you were hoping not to hear.

Plague Keeper Voss.name: Codex-Bound Legwraps
Plague Keeper Voss.flavor_text: Leather stamped with a library's mark. It was a very thorough library.

Plague Keeper Voss.name: Ledger-Pin Brooch
Plague Keeper Voss.flavor_text: A brass pin for holding a page. The page, when you look, is still there.

Vile Plague Abomination.name: Stitchwork Girdle
Vile Plague Abomination.flavor_text: Mail sewn into hide sewn into mail. It stopped being clear which was holding which.

Vile Plague Abomination.name: Vatborn Maul
Vile Plague Abomination.flavor_text: A two-handed mace of fused bone and iron, still warm from wherever it was grown.

Vile Plague Abomination.name: Slab-Hide Pauldrons
Vile Plague Abomination.flavor_text: Plate riveted to a hide that did not consent. The hide, to be fair, no longer objects.

Vile Plague Abomination.name: Gut-Ward Buckler
Vile Plague Abomination.flavor_text: A shield of stretched hide on a bone ring. It flinches before the blow lands.

Dark Sorcerer Zul'keth.name: Crown of the Plague Heart
Dark Sorcerer Zul'keth.flavor_text: A circlet of black iron, grown over with something that pulses in time with the Heart below.

Dark Sorcerer Zul'keth.name: Zul'keth's Corruption Rod
Dark Sorcerer Zul'keth.flavor_text: A short mace of dark glass. Strike something with it and the something remembers being healthy, briefly.

Dark Sorcerer Zul'keth.name: Heartbound Greatcloak
Dark Sorcerer Zul'keth.flavor_text: A cloak the colour of old bruises. It beats, faintly, at the shoulder.

Dark Sorcerer Zul'keth.name: Blightsworn Legplates
Dark Sorcerer Zul'keth.flavor_text: Plate of blackened iron, pitted by something patient. It fits the way an apology fits.
